31:2.text: These are verses of the wise

31:3.text: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good

31:4.text: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain

31:5.text: guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

31:6.text: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech
from the way of Allāh without knowledge and who takes it
in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

31:7.text: And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

31:8.text: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure,

31:9.text: truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

31:10.text: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein

31:11.text: This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.
